text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rain pours from the sky, pounding heavily
against the windows.
According to the
forecast, it should clear up in the
afternoon.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Knock, knock!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Howdy, Trainer! It's rainin' cats and dogs
out there—and on a training
day, no less!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: On that note, I've got a favor to ask!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wait, don't tell me she wants to run in this
downpour? She'll catch a
cold!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Let's make sunshine dolls together!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
My classmates were talking about how
much they wanted to run
outside earlier.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
They were all so disappointed; it was like
the gloom from the storm
had seeped right
into the classroom.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
That's when it hit me—why not make a
sunshine doll? A super big one!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
If it's super big, it'll be super powerful too,
right? Not even a
hurricane will stand a
chance!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
So hand me that curtain over there,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Just you wait—I'll bring the
sun out of hidin' with the
most powerful
sunshine doll you've ever seen!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure this will bring a happy smile to
everyones' faces! So come on,
let's get
started!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While it's great that Taiki's thinking about
her friends, she's trying to
turn the school
curtains into sunshine dolls!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Wh-what? Bigger than a curtain?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We request some old bed sheets from the
nurse's office and sew them
together into a
single large cloth.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And after a bit of refashioning...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Now all that's left is to hang it in the
window! So cheer up, Trainer!
You've got
this!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Whew! Hanging up such a big sunshine
doll is back-breaking work.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
But it sure turned out great! The cute smile
on its face is the best part!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A life-size sunshine doll sways in the
window, making the room feel
like
something out of a haunted house.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeehaaaw! Okay, lookin' good! This bad
boy'll blow the rain clouds
away for
sure—oh!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Look, Trainer! The sun's coming out!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I peer out the window to see that the rain
has stopped and the sun is
beginning to
peek through the clouds.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Amazing! Just goes to show what a true
Japanese magic item and our
power can
do, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Taiki gazing happily up at the sky,
I decide not to tell her
about the weather
forecast.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
That's some perfect training weather! Now
everyone can run at full
power!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'm gonna go take a gander at
everybody's smiling faces!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oblivious to me calling her name, Taiki
bolts off with a skip in her
step.
